title: Senusret III
summary: King of Egypt's Dynasty 12, identified by CFAH with the "Egyptian Belus" of the chroniclers.
description: King of Egypt's Dynasty 12, identified by CFAH with the "Egyptian Belus" of the chroniclers. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "Neferhotep I and Senusret III Synchronism"
reign.note: "Having pinpointed the reign of Senusret III from 1613 to 1573 BC using Anchor Point #59".

reign.date: Start Co-Rex: 1613; Start Sole-rex: 1606; End Sole-rex: 1586; Death or Deposition: 1573
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7A: A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12," OSF preprint of 11 Jun 2025 (no version number), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/GMX5J, file CFAH-7A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12.pdf, Table 3 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 12", p. 55

Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 15 "EKL Solution Dynasties 4, 11, 12, 6", p. 103
